The '''Imperial Transport Commission''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] organization. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], investigators from the Commission were assigned to investigate the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Attack on the Calabar Queen|sabotage]] of the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] ''[[Calabar Queen]]'' above [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai]].
